CustomField.description: Text formula rendering Case_Completion_Pct__c as a unicode progress bar. Add to Related Cases list on Opportunity to give sellers an at-a-glance progress indicator.
CustomField.formula: IF(Case_Completion_Pct__c = 100, "▓▓▓▓▓ 100% ✔", IF(Case_Completion_Pct__c >= 90, "▓▓▓▓░ 90% — awaiting docs", IF(Case_Completion_Pct__c >= 75, "▓▓▓░░ 75%", IF(Case_Completion_Pct__c >= 50, "▓▓░░░ 50%", IF(Case_Completion_Pct__c >= 25, "▓░░░░ 25%", "░░░░░ 0%")))))
CustomField.label: Completion Display
